name: Chang Yen
bio: Chang Yen is dated by Giles to the 9th century AD. His poem here describes a village spring festival.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A Spring Feast
poems.author: Chang Yen

poems.title: 社日 (She ri)
poems.author: Chang Yen
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
鵝湖山下稻粱肥，豚柵雞棲對掩扉。
桑柘影斜春社散，家家扶得醉人歸。
